ruling.recommended_action: Close the fare dispute in the rider's favour on the fare (nothing overcharged: RydeX is fixed-price and the billed distance equals the optimal distance), but record a driver route-deviation violation (RD-1) for internal tracking; no monies move.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 14:19–14:22 added 0.77 km (2.15 km driven vs 1.38 km optimal). RD-5 consent fails: no in-app chat exists [F7], so no rider agreement preceded the deviation; the driver's 'GPS rerouted me' statement [F8] cannot override the GPS record. RD-4 reasonable cause fails: no traffic incident on the replaced optimal-route section [F11], and band 4 speed records [F9/F10] are neither band 1 nor 2, so RD-4(b) cannot exempt a segment. Segment is an unexempted deviation under RD-1.

rejected_claims.reason: Rider seeks refund of 'extra distance', but RydeX is a fixed-quote non-metered service and the billed distance (10.8 km) equals the optimal route distance [F4]; no mileage overcharge occurred, so nothing is refundable under RD-2's non-metered branch.
